dielectric.note: Empirical dielectric loss factor of this work: linear regression of log10(eps'') on log10(VO_total), i.e. eps'' = 10^a * VO^b with a = -3.07028 +/- 0.695 and b = 1.22355 +/- 0.2302 (OriginLab, no weighting, N = 4, Pearson r 0.96637, R^2 0.93388, adj. R^2 0.90082, RSS 0.18029). Fitted over roughly 95-5000 umol-O/g; below that range the value is an extrapolation and the card marks it. Set eps_prime to display tan delta.
dielectric.provenance: Measured in this work (Kwak et al.): dielectric loss factor vs total oxygen-vacancy content from H2O-integration titration of reduced rutile.

scope: This repository computes gas-solid equilibrium and a geometric surface-capacity bound. It does not assign the below-surface inventory among subsurface point defects, bulk defects or extended defects.

geometry_card.provenance: Lattice constants and molar mass are tabulated rutile values. Everything else in this file is arithmetic on them.

reconstruction.provenance: Onishi & Iwasawa: one added Ti2O3 unit per (1x2) cell is one O vacancy per two bridging sites. This is the only structural literature input in this file; the capacity itself is lattice geometry.

surface_cell.area_A2_note: the (110) 1x1 cell is c x a*sqrt(2)
